claim_en: אלה תולדות ("these are the generations" — bare, no joining vav): the Kitzur's list of FOUR juxtaposed headers — the heavens (2:4), Noah (6:9), Shem (11:10), Jacob (37:2) — "each disqualifies what precedes it": chaos, the wicked generations, Ham and Japheth, Esau. SNAPSHOT adjacency: exactly those four (the vav-prefixed headers stand apart).

נח נח... נח — Noah's name written THREE times in his header verse: "he saw three worlds"; "he saved three by his merit" (as Daniel three, as Job three); the rest-homily runs it to six. SNAPSHOT: three tokens in the verse.

את האלהים התהלך נח ("with God walked Noah") — the FINAL letters of the walk-clause spell חכם ("wise"), read tail-first (verse-order מ-כ-ח): "and the wise one takes souls" (Prov 11:30). SNAPSHOT finals locked.
משחיתם את הארץ ("destroying them with the earth") — the INITIAL letters spell מאה ("hundred"): "He destroyed their stature, which was a hundred cubits tall." SNAPSHOT initials locked.

ותמלא ("and it was FILLED") — the Masorah pair: "the earth was filled with violence" (6:11) and "the land was filled with them" (Exod 1:7, Israel multiplying): the Kitzur's measure-for-measure homily rides the pair. SNAPSHOT: exactly two tokens of this form (the she-filled verb, 21:19/24:16, is a different form and stands apart).

והנני ("and behold I" — the destroy-decree) — the Kitzur's Masorah trio spans to the Prophets (the Shiloh house-word; the widow gathering her two sticks, 1 Kgs 17:12): "I said to build the world up, and they ruined it." Torah-side: this is the word's ONLY Torah token.

ושלשים ("and THIRD decks") — the Masorah pair: the ark's third story (6:16) and "they journey THIRD" — the camp banners on the march (Num 2:24): "by the merit of the banners they were saved." SNAPSHOT: exactly two tokens of the third-plural, this pair.

וזה אשר ("and this is what...") opens exactly THREE Torah instructions — the ARK spec (6:15), the ALTAR spec (Exod 29:38), and the permitted-birds law (Deut 14:12). The Kitzur's Masorah pair is the two BUILD-commands (וזה אשר תעשה, "this is what you shall MAKE"): "as the altar atones, so the ark — build an atoning altar when you exit." SNAPSHOT: the three openings locked; the two make-formulas are the pair.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 6:9 (Mikhlol; R. Moshe Kimchi)
claim_en: התהלך־נח ("walked Noah") — "in all the books the lamed with SEGOL (the short e-vowel)" — because the maqqef (joining hyphen) binds it to a first-stressed word; Minchat Shai wonders at the one authority who wrote tsere. SNAPSHOT: segol.
התהלך־נח — the maqqef (joining hyphen) itself, the stated REASON for the segol juncture: SNAPSHOT's maqqef column joins the walk-verb to the walker.

source: Bereshit Rabbah 30:9; Avodah Zarah 6a:2; Bereshit Rabbah 30:10
claim_en: THE HEADER'S EPITHETS ARE PARSED AS A LEGAL DESCRIPTION AND THEN DISPUTED. Because 'righteous' already covers his deeds, תָּמִים (tamim, 'whole') is read as covering his BODY - two adjectives, two domains. The qualifier 'IN HIS GENERATIONS' carries the standing dispute: R. Yehuda reads it as relative praise only (a wine-cellar, a blind marketplace), R. Nechemya as an a-fortiori all-the-more (balsam in a graveyard). And the walking-verb is graded against Abraham's: this man walked WITH God, needing support, where Abraham walked BEFORE Him.

check.note: Two epithets split across two domains; the qualifier's force disputed; the walking-verb graded relative to a later unit.

claim_en: R. Abahu states a particle rule on our 6:9 header: אֵלֶּה ('THESE are') EXCLUDES what preceded it. The section marker the machine reads as structural is read by the chain as an operator of exclusion - the flood generation cut off at this header.

check.note: A section-header particle read as performing an exclusion, not merely a division.

claim_en: חָמָס (chamas) IS DISTINGUISHED FROM ROBBERY BY VALUE THRESHOLD, and the vocabulary is fixed four ways. R. Chanina: chamas is a taking of less than a perutah, robbery a perutah or more - the lupin-basket scene supplying the case. R. Levi gives the word a fourfold field: idolatry, immorality, bloodshed, and its plain sense. And the corruption vocabulary of our 6:11-12 is the derivation base for the Noahide capital-liability list at the Sanhedrin sugya.

check.note: A threshold definition distinguishing two offences, and a corruption vocabulary grounding a capital-liability list.

source: Bereshit Rabbah 31:10; Sanhedrin 108b:10; Bereshit Rabbah 31:11; Sanhedrin 108b:11
claim_en: THE ARK SPEC IS READ AS ENGINEERING, AND THE COMPARTMENT COUNT IS DISPUTED. The dimensions of our 6:15 - three hundred by fifty by thirty cubits, present in the ink - are read as shipwright ratios, breadth a sixth of length and height a tenth, with 'AND this' read as meaning another will measure by your cubit, joining the spec to the Temple's. 'To a cubit finish it above' is read as hull engineering: a wide base narrowing to a top, so the vessel stands and does not capsize. The internal division is disputed three ways across seats - three hundred and sixty compartments at ten by ten, nine hundred at six by six, and a baraita's own three-storey allocation of manure, animals and people - all recorded.

check.note: Numeric spec read as practical shipbuilding instruction, with a three-way seat variance on the compartment census.

source: Avodah Zarah 51a:15; Avodah Zarah 51a:18; Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 9:5:2; Sanhedrin 57a:7
claim_en: THE BOARDING LIST IS READ AS A QUALIFYING STANDARD FOR THE ALTAR. From 6:19's 'of every LIVING thing' R. Elazar rules an animal lacking a limb prohibited for the descendants of Noah; 'WITH YOU' is read as 'similar to you', excluding the mortally injured, with the man himself proven whole from 6:9's 'tamim'. Some of the ark's animals are read as destined for the altar, so the intake spec doubles as an offering-fitness spec. And 6:20's 'after their kind' grounds a recorded dispute over whether the descendants of Noah are commanded against crossbreeding at all.

check.note: An intake roster read as an offering-fitness standard, with a crossbreeding dispute on the same verse.

claim_en: A SPEC-DELTA BETWEEN TWO VESSELS IS READ AS PURPOSE-DRIVEN. Our ark is pitched inside and out; the basket that later carries the infant Moses is clay within and pitch without. The chain reads the difference against the water each must survive - a weak current against a flood - so the two specifications are compared as engineering answers to different loads. The compartment-word is separately joined to the bird-pair purification: 'your ark purifies you'.

check.note: Two vessel specifications in the corpus compared as engineering responses to different conditions.

claim_en: THE ARK-ABSTINENCE LAW IS DERIVED FROM THE LISTING ORDER OF OUR 6:18. At entry the verse lists the men and the women separately - 'you and your sons, and your wife and your sons' wives' - while at the exit of 8:16 they are joined. From that ordering difference the prohibition of intercourse inside the ark is derived, with the famine-abstinence rule riding alongside it. Three are named as having violated it, each marked for it.

check.note: A prohibition derived from the ORDER in which an operator lists its participants, discharged by the corresponding exit verse.

claim_en: A LAW OF PRAISE READ OUT OF AN INK-DIFF BETWEEN TWO VERSES. Our 6:9 calls the man 'righteous, WHOLE in his generations' when speaking about him; 7:1, addressing him to his face, says only 'righteous'. From the difference the rule is drawn: one gives partial praise in a person's presence and full praise in his absence. A model-relevant delta between two of this corpus's own verses becomes a rule of conduct.

check.note: A conduct rule derived from the difference between two descriptions of the same person in adjacent units.

claim_en: Our 6:14's 'MAKE FOR YOURSELF an ark' is enrolled as the first member of a four-place census of the same construction - the ark, the trumpets, the flint knives, and the serpent - three of them explicit and one not. The build command is typed as an instance of a recurring divine construction directive rather than a one-off.

check.note: A build operator typed as a member of a four-place corpus-wide census.

claim_en: LAW FROM OPERAND ORDER. The entry roster separates the couples and the exit roster rejoins them — from here, relations were forbidden in the ark: a law read from nothing but the order of the operands, the three transgressors recorded beside. Filed F-149, auto-seated (round 36, the name-and-ink block).
